title: Share rule, test: deep-long again with 64 MB TCP buffers
description: The deep-long family of exp-share-test-18 (share-test.json) again, with the same episodes (the same controllers, links, conditions and seeds), now that the guest has Sage's and ccBench's TCP buffer limits (64 MB) in place of Linux's own for a 1 GiB guest (a 4 MB send buffer), which capped buffer-filling flows on that family's longer links (docs/validation.md, "TCP buffer limits"). The other families of that run needed at most 3.5 MB in flight and are not rerun.
prepare: G="$IN/grid/$(cat "$IN/grid/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; M="$IN/models"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v4" "$G" --u 0.125; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/oracle" "$M/net1v3.pt" --u 0.375 --oracle; uv run python experiments/share_rule_export.py "$OUT/share" "$G" --u0 0.125 --k 0.5 1; C=(--policy "rule-v4=$OUT/v4/rule-u0.125.onnx" --policy "share-k0.5=$OUT/share/share-u0.125-k0.5.onnx" --policy "share-k1=$OUT/share/share-u0.125-k1.onnx"); P=("${C[@]}" --policy "oracle-u0.375=$OUT/oracle/rule-u0.375-oracle.onnx"); RULE_EVAL_FAMILIES=deep-long:20 experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" test 13 31 all "${P[@]}"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
